title: Show HN: A Handwritten Blogging Platform
originalTitle: Show HN: A Handwritten Blogging Platform
content:
Some thoughts deserve more time.

Writing by hand slows us down.

A place for authentic thinking.

No algorithmic feed. Every blog has RSS. No likes.

Just your pages, published as you wrote them.

See a page.

Perhaps the web could feel a little more human.

Start your own handwritten blog at handwritten.blog.
